name: language-tutor
description: Voice-first language tutor agent bundle — Krashen-aligned comprehensible input + spaced-repetition methodology, CEFR-calibrated to the learner's current level. Default target language is Spanish; configurable via `defaults.targetLanguage` (es / ja / fr / zh / etc.). Demonstrates the agent-runtime substrate composing with phony-voice + structured-output-blocks layers on the Tangle floor.
